select va.application_id, va.visitor_id, va.host_name, va.reason, va.start_time, va.end_time, va.status, va.approve_time, v.name as visitor_name, v.phone as visitor_phone, v.id_card as visitor_id_card, v.company as visitor_company, v.avatar as visitor_avatar, v.plate_no, (select count(1) from visitor_entry e1 where e1.application_id = va.application_id and e1.entry_type = '0' and e1.create_time >= #{dateStart} and e1.create_time < #{nextDayStart}) as entry_count, (select max(e2.create_time) from visitor_entry e2 where e2.application_id = va.application_id and e2.create_time >= #{dateStart} and e2.create_time < #{nextDayStart}) as last_entry_time, (select e3.entry_type from visitor_entry e3 where e3.application_id = va.application_id order by e3.create_time desc limit 1) as last_event_type from visitor_application va left join visitor v on va.visitor_id = v.visitor_id where va.status = '1' and va.del_flag = '0' and va.start_time < #{nextDayStart} and va.end_time >= #{dateStart}
and ( v.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.id_card like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.plate_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and not exists (select 1 from visitor_entry e4 where e4.application_id = va.application_id)
and #{onSiteStatus} = (select e5.entry_type from visitor_entry e5 where e5.application_id = va.application_id order by e5.create_time desc limit 1)
order by va.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into visitor_entry(entry_id, application_id, entry_type, operator_id, operator_name, create_time) values (#{entryId}, #{applicationId}, #{entryType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select entry_id, application_id, entry_type, operator_id, operator_name, create_time from visitor_entry where application_id = #{applicationId} order by create_time desc limit 1

select ve.entry_id, ve.application_id, ve.entry_type, ve.operator_name, ve.create_time as entry_time, v.name as visitor_name, v.company as visitor_company, v.phone as visitor_phone, v.id_card as visitor_id_card, v.plate_no, va.host_name, va.start_time, va.end_time from visitor_entry ve left join visitor_application va on ve.application_id = va.application_id left join visitor v on va.visitor_id = v.visitor_id where 1 = 1
and v.name like concat('%', #{visitorName}, '%')
and va.host_name like concat('%', #{hostName}, '%')
and v.plate_no like concat('%', #{plateNo}, '%')
and ve.entry_type = #{entryType}
and ve.create_time >= #{beginTime}
and ve.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
order by ve.create_time desc
